text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa...! ――Ha, haha! Hahahaha! 
Finally... I've climbed to the very top!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
The pinnacle of Longchamp! The throne of 
the strongest— Now, look up at me!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I am the first-magnitude star shining at 
the pinnacle of the world— —"Sirius 
Symboli"!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Hey!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It wasn't Longchamp Racecourse―― but 
rather, an airport in Paris."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Pull yourself together. ...How long are 
you gonna sit there wallowing?"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"—Beyond this lies the 'world' I strive 
for. Once I seize it... everyone will know 
who stands at the pinnacle, won't they?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Conquering the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe 
had been her dream ever since the day we 
met."
choice_data_list:
It feels like a dream, I'm just so 
happy...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Just remembering the sight of her holding 
up that trophy brings tears to my eyes."
choice_data_list:
Thank you for showing me such a wonderful 
view.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she murmured that, a tear she had been 
holding back slipped down her cheek.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
First you, then those Symboli family 
geezers, then the juniors, and then 
Rudolf—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Moved to tears by a happy ending? Every 
last one of you is hopelessly soft-headed.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, I reached the summit of 
Longchamp. That had been my goal for a 
very long time.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
However—the story isn't over. I won't let 
it end.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
There are countless ways to shine brighter 
than this. As many as there are stars in 
the sky.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Though... it seems that whimpering little 
puppy has no desire to see what lies 
ahead."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hah. If that's the case, tighten your 
collar and keep up closely.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I will carve out a new flight path once 
again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her back, strolling leisurely toward her 
next destination, shone most beautifully 
of all beneath the blue sky.
